summary: Iter41 — Mercado Pago Marketplace OAuth Multi-Account expansion: 13/13 NEW tests PASS. Coverage: (1) OAuth start endpoint returns 200 with authorize_url containing client_id=7849343570174391, response_type=code, platform_id=mp, state (3-part nonce.email_b64.hmac, sig=32 hex chars) and canonical redirect_uri ending in /api/admin/mercadopago/oauth/callback; auth required (401 without token). (2) OAuth callback 302-redirects to /admin/mercadopago with mp_oauth=error for: ?error=access_denied (reason=User+denied), tampered state (reason=state_invalid via HMAC compare_digest), and missing code (reason=missing_code). (3) core/crypto unit tests: encrypt_token wraps with 'enc::' prefix, decrypt roundtrips exactly, encrypt(encrypt(x)) == encrypt(x) (idempotent), plaintext passes through decrypt unchanged (retro-compat), passthrough when MP_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY absent, empty/None returns input. (4) POST /admin/mercadopago/connect with the existing sandbox APP_USR token persists access_token_pasarela starting with 'enc::' in MongoDB (verified by direct pymongo read), sets mp_connection_mode='manual', clears mp_refresh_token & mp_expires_at; status returns encrypted_at_rest=true. (5) Status endpoint exposes all new fields: connection_mode, encrypted_at_rest, encryption_available=true, expires_at=None, has_refresh_token=false, fee_percent=0.0 (MARKETPLACE_FEE_PERCENT=0 in .env). (6) Webhook multi-org resolver: in-process ASGITransport test with monkeypatched mercadopago_service.obtener_pago returning metadata.admin_email pointing to a SEPARATE TEST_alt_admin doc — webhook returns 200 ok=true, code tolerates multi-org and called obtener_pago at least once (re-route path exercised via decrypt_token of alt admin's encrypted token). MP_CLIENT_ID confirmed = 7849343570174391, redirect_uri = https://padel-tournament-hub-9.preview.emergentagent.com/api/admin/mercadopago/oauth/callback. NO bugs found in the new code — Fernet helper, OAuth state HMAC, and metadata routing all behave per spec. Pre-existing test_mercadopago_marketplace.py has 9 stale failures NOT caused by this expansion (webhook MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET now enforced → old tests need x-signature header; PhoneStr validator now rejects '+521TEST_*' literal — see action items).

minor.issue: Old iter5_mp suite expects 200 but now correctly returns 401 (MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET configured). Old tests are stale — not a code bug. New iter41 webhook test bypasses by monkeypatching MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET='' for in-process ASGI run.

Stale iter5_mp tests send telefono='+521TEST_NX1' which is rejected (422) by tightened PhoneStr validator (requires +52 + 10 digits). Not caused by Marketplace OAuth changes — pre-existing test drift.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Refresh /app/backend/tests/test_mercadopago_marketplace.py — its 9 stale failures are unrelated to this iteration (MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET enforcement + tighter PhoneStr). Suggested fixes: (a) compute x-signature header in webhook tests, (b) replace '+521TEST_*' phones with '+5215512345001'-style digits-only.

NICE-TO-HAVE: Add a /api/admin/mercadopago/oauth/refresh endpoint that calls mp_oauth.refresh_access_token(refresh_token) and re-encrypts the rotated refresh_token. Currently the helper exists but no router wires it — admins whose 6-month OAuth token nears expiry would need manual reconnect.
NICE-TO-HAVE: Persist `payer_email` and `metadata.admin_email` in mp_transactions explicitly so reporting can attribute revenue per admin without re-querying MP.

DOC: Document in README that MP_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY rotation requires re-encrypting every admins.access_token_pasarela (and mp_refresh_token) — currently decrypt_token returns None silently if Fernet InvalidToken (just logs error). Consider an admin maintenance endpoint to migrate.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/mercadopago._sign_oauth_state / _verify_oauth_state: HMAC-SHA256 with hmac.compare_digest is correct. Padding-safe base64 decode of email handles the rstrip('=') trick well. Good.
routers/mercadopago.mp_oauth_callback: ordering of checks is correct (error first → missing code/state → state HMAC → exchange). RedirectResponse(302) consistently used. ✅
mp_oauth_service.build_authorize_url: uses httpx.QueryParams for url-encoding individual values — works but is verbose. Could be simplified with urllib.parse.urlencode(params). Not a bug, just style.

mp_oauth_service.exchange_code_for_tokens: distinguishes 400/401 (ValueError → user-actionable) from 5xx (RuntimeError → infra). The router catches ValueError → reason=exchange_rejected and bare Exception → reason=exchange_failed. ✅

core/crypto._get_fernet: lazy singleton with _initialized guard is good for unit-testability (tests reset both flags). The 'enc::' prefix sentinel is a clean migration strategy; existing plaintext tokens transparently coexist.
core/crypto.decrypt_token: returns None on InvalidToken — callers in routers/mercadopago.py correctly check 'if not access_token' and raise 503. ✅

routers/mercadopago.webhook_mercadopago multi-org branch (lines 762-778): re-fetches payment with alternative admin's token only if admin_email_meta differs AND alt_token decrypts AND differs from current. Defensive: silently keeps original payment on alt fetch failure. ✅

routers/mercadopago.MpStatus.fee_percent uses mp_oauth.marketplace_fee_percent() helper which reads MARKETPLACE_FEE_PERCENT then falls back to legacy MP_PLATFORM_FEE_PERCENT. Backwards compatible — good.

Potential minor issue: in checkout_mercadopago after decrypt_token() fails the code raises 503 'Token MP corrupto/no descifrable. Reconecta MP.' — but the cupos reservation lock has NOT been taken yet, so no rollback needed. ✅

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/backend/tests/test_iter41_mp_marketplace_oauth.py as the Marketplace OAuth regression suite. Key facts: (a) state format is '<nonce>.<email_b64>.<hmac32hex>' — DO NOT change format without updating tests. (b) crypto singleton must be reset between tests that monkeypatch the env: `crypto._fernet_singleton=None; crypto._initialized=False`. (c) Webhook signature is ENFORCED when MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set — in-process tests must monkeypatch.setenv('MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET','') before calling. (d) anyio.run(coro) is the cleanest way to drive ASGITransport from a sync pytest function without pytest-asyncio. (e) MARKETPLACE_FEE_PERCENT=0 in .env → fee_percent=0.0 — if main agent ever bumps env (e.g. 10), the status test will need update. (f) The MP test seller token APP_USR-1598112764080275-... is the same one used since iter5; do not rotate without updating /app/memory/test_credentials.md. (g) The OAuth exchange code path was NOT tested e2e (we have no real MP `code`) but exchange_code_for_tokens raises ValueError on 400/401 from MP — covered indirectly by 'reason=exchange_rejected' redirect contract in the callback.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in the new Marketplace OAuth code. All 13 new acceptance tests pass on first run. The 9 failures observed in /app/backend/tests/test_mercadopago_marketplace.py are PRE-EXISTING drift, not caused by this iteration: (1) webhook tests no longer pass because MP_WEBHOOK_SECRET was added to .env in a previous iteration and the router now correctly enforces HMAC validation (401 returned); (2) checkout/stripe tests send '+521TEST_NX1' which a tightened PhoneStr validator now rejects with 422. Both are valid backend behaviors — the stale tests need to be refreshed (see action items).
